lead.question: 作者的“新年决心”为何接连失败？究竟是什么最终让他的读书计划泡了汤？
lead.warmup: 每到新年，人们总要立决心：早起、少吃、多陪孩子。可这些决心年年重复，却总难实现。作者总结出原因：目标太宏大、无暇实施，还忍不住向人宣布。于是今年他改了策略，把决心藏在心里，只定两项适中任务——早晨锻炼、晚上读书。通宵晚会、艰苦的自律、家人围观轮番考验着他，且看决心如何消退。
goals: 掌握 resolution、resolve、self-discipline、ambition 等本课核心词汇及搭配。
理解不定式在句中作宾语、同位语、目的状语等成分的用法。
体会现在完成时（I still haven't given up / I have just bought）的表达效果。
学会用 However、Nevertheless 等词表达转折与让步，梳理叙事逻辑。
lead.summary: 课文以幽默自嘲的口吻讲述作者两次新年决心的失败：锻炼计划因热情减退、时间从十一分钟递减到零而归零；读书计划则败给电视的诱惑，一晚在屏幕前打瞌睡后故态复萌。作者借此点明决心难行的根源——目标过于宏大、无暇实施、又轻率宣布，并暗示唯有切合实际的计划与持久的自律才能真正奏效。
lead.tips: 注意区分动词 resolve（决心做，resolve to do sth）与名词 resolution（决心，常与 make/keep/give up 搭配）；另 carry out 意为“实施、执行”，不要与 carry on（继续）混淆。

questions.q: What marked the end of the writer's New Year resolutions?
questions.zh: 是什么标志着作者新年决心的终结？
questions.a: The night he went downstairs, sat in front of the television pretending to read, and soon dozed off in front of the screen.
questions.aZh: 那一夜他下楼坐在电视机前假装看书，很快就在屏幕前打起瞌睡来。
questions.hint: 答案在课文结尾：That proved to be my undoing, for I soon got back to my old bad habit of dozing off in front of the screen.

questions.q: According to the text, why do some people remain inveterate smokers?
questions.zh: 根据课文，为什么有些人烟瘾大、戒不掉？
questions.a: Because they have so often experienced the frustration that results from failure.
questions.aZh: 因为他们屡戒屡败，饱尝失败带来的挫败感，失去了信心。
questions.hint: 见课文：If we remain inveterate smokers, it is only because we have so often experienced the frustration that results from failure.

questions.q: Why do most of us fail in our efforts at self-improvement?
questions.zh: 我们大多数人想自我完善为什么却失败了？
questions.a: Because our schemes are too ambitious and we never have time to carry them out.
questions.aZh: 因为我们的规划过于宏大，而根本抽不出时间去实施。
questions.hint: 见课文：our schemes are too ambitious and we never have time to carry them out。

questions.q: What were the writer's two modest ambitions this year?
questions.zh: 今年作者给自己定下的两项适中的任务是什么？
questions.a: To do physical exercise every morning and to read more of an evening.
questions.aZh: 每天早上锻炼身体，每天晚上多看点书。
questions.hint: 见课文：I limited myself to two modest ambitions: to do physical exercise every morning and to read more of an evening.

questions.q: What does the writer's experience suggest about making New Year resolutions?
questions.zh: 作者的经历对我们立新年决心有什么启示？
questions.a: Resolutions should be kept to oneself and made modest and practical, for ambitious schemes without time and self-discipline are bound to fail.
questions.aZh: 决心最好藏在心里、定得切合实际，因为脱离时间与自律的宏大计划注定失败。
questions.hint: 综合全文，尤其是 announce 决心的教训、two modest ambitions 以及最终故态复萌的结局。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我们决心每天早晨起得早些，吃得少些。
exercises.a: We resolve to get up earlier each morning and eat less.
exercises.note: resolve to do sth 决心做某事

exercises.q: 句型转换：用 can't 改写 Certain accomplishments are beyond attainment.
填空：I still ______ (not give) up my resolution to do more reading.（用正确时态）
exercises.note: 现在完成时 haven't given up

exercises.q: 改错：We also make the fundamental error of announce our resolutions to everybody.
exercises.note: 介词 of 后接动名词

exercises.q: 填空：I have just bought a book ______ (entitle) How to Read a Thousand Words a Minute.
汉译英：我给自己定下两项适中的任务：每天早上锻炼身体，每天晚上多看点书。
exercises.a: I limited myself to two modest ambitions: to do physical exercise every morning and to read more of an evening.

exercises.q: 句型转换：The daily exercises lasted only eleven minutes. But the self-discipline required was considerable.（用 Although 合并）
exercises.a: Although the daily exercises lasted only eleven minutes, the self-discipline required was considerable.

quiz.q: 作者认为大多数人想自我完善却失败，主要原因是什么？
options: Their schemes are too ambitious and they never have time to carry them out.
They simply forget what they have resolved to do.
They cannot afford the time and money to improve themselves.
They are too lazy to get up early in the morning.
quiz.note: 见课文 schemes are too ambitious

quiz.q: 课文中的 inveterate smokers 指的是一类怎样的人？
options: Those who smoke only on special occasions.
Those who have never tried to stop smoking.
Those who have smoked for a long time and can hardly give it up.
Those who smoke secretly in the evening.

quiz.q: 作者说把新年决心向大家宣布，会带来什么后果？
options: Your friends will help you carry out your resolutions.
You look even more foolish when you slip back into your bad old ways.
You will feel more confident and work harder.
Your family will stop laughing at you.

quiz.q: 今年作者对自己的决心采取了什么新做法？
options: He wrote his resolutions down and showed them to everybody.
He gave up making any resolutions at all.
He joined an all-night party to celebrate the New Year.
He kept his resolutions to himself and set only two modest ambitions.

quiz.q: 作者所说的自我约束（self-discipline）具体指什么？
options: The effort of dragging himself out of bed eleven minutes earlier than usual.
The determination to eat less at breakfast every morning.
The courage to fend off the taunts of his family.
The patience to read a thousand words a minute.

quiz.q: 关于多读书的决心，作者最后是怎么处理的？
options: He has completely forgotten it and never buys any books.
He gave it up after falling asleep in front of the screen.
He still hasn't given it up and has just bought a book to help him read faster.
He has already finished reading a thousand words a minute.
quiz.note: 见 I still haven't given up...
